en.t: The cool moon was about to sink in the west.

units.source_text: 西面边门外的过廊早已坍塌，屋檐亦不留剩，毫无遮蔽，月光明晃晃地射入，把室内照得洞然若昼。

en.t: The passageway outside the side gate on the west had long since collapsed, and not even the eaves remained; with nothing to block it, the bright moonlight poured in and lit the room as clearly as day.

units.source_text: 但见其中一切布置陈设，与昔年毫无变异，

en.t: Inside, however, all the arrangements and furnishings appeared completely unchanged from former years,

units.source_text: 比较起蓬蒿丛生的外貌来，另有一种优雅之趣。

en.t: and compared with the weed-choked appearance outside, they had a distinct grace and charm of their own.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想起古代故事中，有用帷屏上的垂布做成衣服的贫女。

en.t: Prince Genji thought of a poor woman in an old tale who made clothing from the hanging cloth of a screen.

units.source_text: 末摘花大约曾与这贫女同样地度过多年的痛苦生涯，实甚可悯。

en.t: Safflower must have passed many painful years much like that poor woman, and she was truly pitiable.

units.source_text: 此人向来一味谦让退逊，毕竟是品质高尚之故，亦属优雅可喜。

en.t: Her constant modesty and reserve were, after all, signs of a noble character, and this too was graceful and pleasing.

units.source_text: 源氏公子一直未能忘情于她。

en.t: Prince Genji had never been able to put her out of his heart.

units.source_text: 只因年来忧患频仍，以致心绪昏乱，与她音问隔绝，谅她必然怨恨自己，便十分可怜她。

en.t: Only because troubles had followed one after another in recent years, leaving his mind in confusion, had he lost touch with her; thinking that she must surely resent him, he felt deeply sorry for her.

units.source_text: 源氏公子又去访了花散里，她也并无显然迎合时世的娇艳模样，

en.t: Prince Genji also went to visit Lady Hanachirusato, and she too had no showy beauty that plainly catered to the fashions of the day,

units.source_text: 两相比较，并无多少差异，因而末摘花的短处便隐晦得多了。

en.t: so when the two were compared, there was not much difference between them, and Safflower's shortcomings became far less noticeable.
